assign.request: Port three more MIT Codrops demos: a menu/navigation effect framed in the paging vocabulary (which mechanism), an image or grid transition, a hover-driven layout change. Add to the hub's DEMOS and children. Prove with ui-test at four widths and reduced-motion.
assign.now: scoping - read round-3.md, requirements.md, round-2.md, codrops readme, paging mechanism vocabulary
steps: read briefs + round 1/2 rules + paging mechanism vocabulary
shortlist + license-check candidate repos (github MIT search)
read source of 3 chosen repos, decide substitutions
wire into codrops hub (DEMOS + children + table)

log.msg: Licence pass (same method as rounds 1-2: api.github.com/search/repositories?q=org:codrops+license:mit, then the actual LICENSE file, never the badge). Shortlisted via keyword search (menu, grid, accordion): ExpandingRoundedMenu, MakeWayGridEffect, GridZoom, InlineMenuLayout, MenuThumbStackAnimation. Read LICENSE for the three picked - ExpandingRoundedMenu, GridZoom, MakeWayGridEffect - all genuine MIT (Codrops 2009-2021), READMEs clean (no redistribution caveat, images credited to Unsplash only).

Picked: ExpandingRoundedMenu (a pill-shaped top-bar menu that grows in place into a full nav panel on click) for the menu/nav slot - maps to this realm's own expand mechanism (opens below, in place, item grows, nothing else moves) since it never navigates or moves the surrounding content. GridZoom (click a grid tile, it scales up via FLIP into a detail panel, other tiles fade) for the image/grid transition slot. MakeWayGridEffect (click an item, it scales up and neighbours translate away proportional to distance) for the hover-driven layout slot - the original triggers on click; ported to hover (mouseenter/mouseleave) per the brief's ask for a hover-driven change, noted as a substitution. All three ship GSAP (ExpandingRoundedMenu, MakeWayGridEffect) or GSAP+multiple JS modules (GridZoom: grid.js/contentItem.js/textReveal.js/textLinesReveal.js/slide-nav) - same round-1/2 answer: reimplement the mechanism in plain CSS/JS, note the drop in the table. Rejected from the shortlist: InlineMenuLayout and MenuThumbStackAnimation (both good fits too, but three is the ask; kept for a future round).

assign.now: built all 3: expand-menu, grid-zoom, make-way; wired into hub

log.msg: Real bug found+fixed via ui-test's own screenshot (not a gesture-check flag): make-way's hovered tile scales from its CENTER (default transform-origin), so an edge/top-row tile grows both up/left and down/right - the top-left tile overlapped the prose paragraph ABOVE the grid at 400px width. Fixed by wrapping the bare .grid.auto in a new padded .codrops-way-stage (3em padding, same bounded-box pattern as the other demos) instead of clipping the effect itself. Re-verified: no overlap in the fixed screenshot, zero real overflow (sw===cw) at all 4 widths before and after the fix.

Second bug, in my own test tooling not the page: the first still.png capture script located '.grid.auto' to screenshot make-way's grid, which matched the CODROPS HUB's own card wall instead (Miller-columns keeps prior columns in the DOM as peers at wide viewports - the ui-test skill's own documented trap, 'a columns page holds TWO of every selector'). Wrong still.png showed grid-hover's card + table text. Fixed by scoping to the page-specific '.codrops-way-stage' class; re-verified the still now shows make-way's own hover effect. expand-menu and grid-zoom's stills were unaffected (already scoped to their own unique .codrops-expand-stage/.codrops-zoom-stage classes).

ui-test: drive.mjs plans (400 to 1280 to 1920 to 3440 via mid-run 'viewport' verb + a fresh 'goto' per width, one plan per demo) all green. expand-menu: click .codrops-expand-open opens the panel (grid-template-rows 0fr to 1fr, height +27px then +201px across 2 shots), click .codrops-expand-back closes it (-15, -33). grid-zoom: click tile 1 grows it via the FLIP transform (+60w/+149h then +20w/+50h) and opens the content panel; back button closes. make-way: hover tile 1 grows it (+65w/+65h) and pushes tile 2 away (+56dx); move-away settles both back to 0. Zero real document overflow at every width for all 3 (doc.sw===doc.cw checked directly in steps.json - the 'offscreen-x' per-element flags after a mid-run viewport resize are the known stale-viewport-closure false positive round 1/2 also hit, cross-checked). Zero console errors once still.png existed for all 3 (3 404s each beforehand, same expected pattern as prior rounds).

prefers-reduced-motion: separate Playwright script (reducedMotion:'reduce' context) confirmed all 3 collapse to instant - transition-duration reads 0s on the animated element in each demo, and the DOM already shows the FINAL state (open grid-template-rows value / final scaled tile rect) within 50ms of the gesture, i.e. no mid-transition frame. All PASS.

links.label: Expanding menu (this realm's own expand mechanism)

assign.outcome: **Codrops round 3 lands: three more MIT demos, all wired into the hub.** [`/imagine/codrops/`](/imagine/codrops/) now shows 9 cards + a 9-row table. New: [Expanding menu](/imagine/codrops/expand-menu/) — ported from `ExpandingRoundedMenu` (MIT), a pill-shaped bar that grows in place into a full nav panel, framed as this realm's own [`expand`](/imagine/paging/mechanisms/expand/) mechanism (imported straight from `paging.js`'s `MECHANISMS` table, not retyped). [Grid zoom](/imagine/codrops/grid-zoom/) — ported from `GridZoom` (MIT), a click-to-zoom grid transition built on the textbook 3-line FLIP technique (measure, invert, one CSS `transition: transform`) instead of GSAP's Flip plugin. [Make way](/imagine/codrops/make-way/) — ported from `MakeWayGridEffect` (MIT), a genuinely hover-driven layout change: hovering one tile scales it up and every other tile leans away, proportional to distance (the original's own `map`/`getDistance`/`getTranslationDistance` maths, ported unchanged) — the original's trigger was click, moved to hover per this round's ask. All three drop GSAP for plain CSS transitions, documented per-demo in the table. Two real bugs found and fixed via ui-test's own screenshots (not just its flags): (1) make-way's hovered tile scales from its own centre, so an edge tile grew into the prose *above* the grid — fixed with a new padded `.codrops-way-stage` wrapper, the same bounded-box pattern the other demos already use; (2) my own still.png capture script for make-way used the generic `.grid.auto` selector, which matched the *hub's* card wall instead of make-way's own grid (Miller-columns keeps prior columns in the DOM at wide viewports) — fixed by scoping to `.codrops-way-stage`. `ui-test` (drive.mjs, 4 widths each via mid-run `viewport` + a fresh `goto`) all green: zero real horizontal overflow (`doc.sw===doc.cw` checked directly, cross-checking the known stale-viewport `offscreen-x` false positive rounds 1/2 also hit), zero console errors once stills existed, a clean re-check at 1600px for all 3 pages + readme. A separate `reducedMotion:'reduce'` Playwright context confirmed all three collapse to instant (`transition-duration: 0s`, DOM already at its final state within 50ms of the gesture) — PASS. Rejected from the shortlist: `InlineMenuLayout` and `MenuThumbStackAnimation` (both good menu/nav fits too, but three is the ask — kept for a future round). Private server (port 8133, killed on landing) — never touched port 80.
